## 4. Rush order approval

Rush-order fees are billable only when the purchase order or written sponsor approval identifies the lot, requested ship date, and rush service level. Supplier-initiated schedule recovery is not billable as a rush order.

## 4. Minimum evidence for approval

An invoice line may be approved only when the billed supplier, product, SKU, batch, milestone, material, capacity period, or shipment can be tied to an authorized source document.

## 5. Included quality documentation

Standard certificate of analysis, material safety data sheet, and lot traceability documentation are included in the unit cost. Additional quality documentation is billable only when the sponsor requests a non-standard document set.

## 3. Capacity reservation

The sponsor may reserve regional capacity by month. Capacity reservation charges are billable only for months listed in the active purchase order. If the sponsor cancels reserved capacity at least 45 calendar days before the first scheduled run, the reservation charge is not billable.

## 4. Minimum evidence for approval

An invoice line may be approved only when the billed supplier, product, SKU, batch, milestone, material, capacity period, or shipment can be tied to an authorized source document.

## 2. Regional price tiers

The base production price is USD 0.39 per released tablet for monthly released volume below 2,000,000 tablets.

Monthly released volume of 2,000,000 tablets or more qualifies for the regional high-volume price of USD 0.36 per released tablet for all released units in that month.
